Send.It Send.it helps you to share your media easily over local network instead of internet. This app requires wifi connection to work. Two devices must be connected to same wifi network and need to have Send.It installed. When should you use Send.it? You can use send.it to send your media files to nearby Android device (soon you will be able to send them to Desktop also). e.g. if you have captured some high quality videos and the amount of data too much, and you want to share this videos to the person standing near you. in that case you can use Send.It to share this data easily without losing any quality and as this process does not require active internet connection your data is not going to any third party server so your all privacy is in your control Welcome to Send.It Before starting the Send.It there are few things that needs to be set up, please provide few details that you can get the best from the Send.It Send.It allows you to easily share your media to the devices nearby. so it requires your permission to access your media so you can easily select whatever media content you want to share with others." + "Send.It is not made to share your data to any third party server it is only capable to share data on local network. " + "There is no need for active internet connection for Send.It to work only two devices must connected with wifi network. " + "Whether this Wifi is connected to internet or not is irrelevant Android 14 introduces Selected Photos and Video Access, which allows you to grant Send.It to access specific images and videos from your device, rather than granting access to all media of a given type. This is android\'s new step to strengthen the user\'s privacy. this also affects how Send.It access your media. As Send.It does not connected to any third party server your media isn\'t going anywhere on internet directly. So you can select Allow all for the media selection or select limited amount of media and add more photos or videos next time you want If other device do not have Send.It install, Share them the link to install, click on below button. Share This App Hello I\'m using Send.It to sharing my photos and videos with nearby devices, it\'s easy and quick. You can also try this, click on the link below to download it from the play store.
